cobblemon.species.tuligant.name: Tuligant
cobblemon.species.tuligant.desc: An alternate evolution of Petilil, and a counterpart of Lilligant. It uses the flower atop its head to absorb moonlight to help it grow. It is said that a Tuligant's petals can revive people from their deathbeds... But at the cost of a terrible curse.
cobblemon.species.papersol.name: Papersol
cobblemon.species.papersol.desc: The parasol on its head protects its paper body from wrinkling in the harsh sunlight. Despite resembling an umbrella this Pokémon is made of paper so it avoids the rain at all costs.
cobblemon.species.umbrelligant.name: Umbrelligant
cobblemon.species.umbrelligant.desc: Using its stilt-like legs, this Pokémon walks across rivers and ponds to keep cool without risk of its paper body touching the water. The parasol on its head protects it from the harsh summer sun.
cobblemon.species.pillowisp.name: Pillowisp
cobblemon.species.pillowisp.desc: When a pillow is inhabited by a wandering spirit laying to rest, it becomes this Pokémon. Its pillowcase body is filled with magic sand that inherits the Pokemon’s dreams. It is said that if you lay your head on this Pokémon’s pillow-like body, you will dream happy dreams.
cobblemon.species.pillowisp_bad.desc: When a pillow is inhabited by a wandering spirit laying to rest, it becomes this Pokémon. Its pillowcase body is filled with magic sand that inherits the Pokémon’s dreams. It is said that if you lay your head on this Pokémon’s pillow-like body, you will be tormented by nightmares.
cobblemon.species.dreaneuma.name: Dreaneuma
cobblemon.species.dreaneuma.desc: After being imbued with positive thoughts, this Pokémon has evolved. Under the light of the full moon, it enters into people’s homes to sprinkle its magic sand around their beds. The sand that makes up its body is said to fill people’s dreams with peace and happiness.
cobblemon.species.phantasmare.name: Phantasmare
cobblemon.species.phantasmare.desc: After being imbued with negative thoughts, this Pokémon has evolved. In the darkness of the New Moon, this Pokémon sneaks into people’s bedrooms to sprinkle their beds with its magic sand. The sand that makes up its body induces terrifying nightmares.
cobblemon.species.slugrit.name: Slugrit
cobblemon.species.slugrit.desc: A convergent evolution that resembles Slugma. Its body is made entirely of sand and rock. It lays flat in the sun to keep itself heated, blending in with the desert terrain.
cobblemon.species.dunecargo.name: Dunecargo
cobblemon.species.dunecargo.desc: A convergent evolution that resembles Magcargo. The large rock shell on its back is full of the sand that makes up its body. It travels with the wind, wandering slowly across the dunes. When confronted, it throws burning hot sand at its foes.
cobblemon.species.lucario-midnight.name: Lucario
cobblemon.species.lucario-midnight.desc: Its fighting style is ruthless and brutal, and it shows its opponents no mercy. Its aura is overflowing, allowing it to sense its opponent's moves before they even make them. When the eyes on its hands open, it launches bursts of aura that can turn steel into dust.
It radiates a powerful aura due to the power of Mega Evolution. Using this power, it can fire off pulses of aura that can shatter solid diamond. It has no mercy in its heart.
cobblemon.species.ralts-midnight.name: Ralts
cobblemon.species.ralts-midnight.desc: Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head, and feeds off of the fear of others... Unfortunately, its also a scaredy-cat itself. It will often jump out to scare people, only to get spooked when they scream.
cobblemon.species.kirlia-midnight.name: Kirlia
cobblemon.species.kirlia-midnight.desc: It is said that a Kirlia will absorb the negative emotions of its trainer. This Pokémon prefers to keep to itself, picking petals off of flowers and thinking melancholy thoughts.
cobblemon.species.gardevoir-midnight.des: It uses its elegant appearance to lure people in, giving them a false sense of security before biting their neck and draining them of their vitality. Despite being known for its vanity, many folktales claim that this Pokémon has no reflection.
cobblemon.species.gardevoir-mega-midnigh: The immense energy brought upon by Mega Evolution grants it immense power, but at a cost of triggering its appetite. If its trainer isn't careful, Gardevoir may try to sneak a bite to drain some of their vitality.
cobblemon.species.gallade-midnight.name: Gallade
cobblemon.species.gallade-midnight.desc: This Pokémon has the ability to disappear into shadows. It uses this skill to ambush people and Pokémon, incapacitating them with its blades before draining them of their vitality. People who live near its territory caution to stay away from shady locations.
By channeling the power of Mega Evolution, it can cast the area around it in shadows even under the brightest sunlight.
cobblemon.species.pumpkaboom.name: Pumpkaboom
cobblemon.species.pumpkaboom.desc: Kaboom! This convergent evolution of Pumpkaboo is full of explosive energy. Its internal flame is bursting with heat, and it loves to sneak up on people before frightening them with a huge explosion.
cobblemon.species.gourgrenade.name: Gourgrenade
cobblemon.species.gourgrenade.desc: Gourgrenade is a convergent evolution of Gourgeist. In the dark of night, it awakens from its pumpkin patch searching for unsuspecting victims. When it finds one, it showers pumpkin grenades around them in an attempt to scare them.
cobblemon.species.norstar.name: Norstar
cobblemon.species.norstar.desc: Despite looking like a starfish, it's actually made entirely of magnetic metals. The magnetic pull of the planet allows it to balance perfectly straight on the tip of its bottom leg.
cobblemon.species.starstellation.name: Starstellar
cobblemon.species.starstellation.desc: It uses its six legs to redirect magnetic fields. Some say they are even able to direct the stars with this power.
cobblemon.species.starstellation-mega.de: Mega Starstellar is seemingly designed for spcae travel, being able to withstand the cold darkness of the cosmos. Some theorize this is the form it had before it came to this planet.
cobblemon.species.hatenna-midnight.name: Hatenna
cobblemon.species.hatenna-midnight.desc: This Pokémon is sensitive to human emotions. Because of this, it does everything it can to keep people happy. It uses its hat to perform all sorts of tricks to impress others.
cobblemon.species.hattrix.name: Hattrix
cobblemon.species.hattrix.desc: Hattrix uses the braids on its head to juggle fireballs. It puts on performances to cheer people up when they're sad, because its sensitive to negative emotion.
cobblemon.species.hattertainer.name: Hattertainer
cobblemon.species.hattertainer.desc: It can't stand long periods of silence, so it often goes out of its way to be around others. In an attempt to keep people happy, it likes to put on grand and over-the-top performances to wow the audience. If it senses negative emotions like anger, jealousy, or annoyance, it adopts those emotions and retaliate with a flaming whip.
cobblemon.species.hattertainer-gmax.desc: It hides inside of its hat waiting for someone to approach. Because of its size, its not very discrete... When it bursts out in a fiery explosion, it gets confused as to why people are running in fear instead of cheering.
cobblemon.species.goodra-bogland.name: Goodra
cobblemon.species.goodra-wetland.name: Goodra
cobblemon.species.goodra-bogland.desc: To survive in the muddy boglands, Goodra developed more potent toxins within its slime. It lays down in the mud all day long to keep its skin from drying out, and to conserve its energy. Its metabolism is slow but efficient, allowing it survive longer off of less food. This is what gives it its sluggish demeanor.
cobblemon.species.goodra-wetland.desc: To survive in flooded wetlands, Goodra's body adapted to a more aquatic lifestyle. Its blubber allows it to float on top of the water with ease. It is often seen drifting down river rapids at high speeds, seemingly as a form of play.
cobblemon.species.fomantis_lunar.name: Fomantis
cobblemon.species.fomantis_lunar.desc: Unlike its tropical counterpart, this form of Fomantis is nocturnal. It awakens from its slumber to bask in the full moon's light, using this energy for photosynthesis. The light of the moon strengthens its psychic powers.
cobblemon.species.lurantis_lunar.name: Lurantis
cobblemon.species.lurantis_lunar.desc: This Pokémon uses its orchid-like appearance to blend into its surrounding as it soaks in moonlight. Although it resembles a bug, its actually a flower. It goes into a mantis-like stance and attacks with psychic blades when threatened by bug types drawn to its scent.
cobblemon.species.falinks-last-soldier.d: Even after losing its five troopers in battle, the Last Soldier refuses to retreat. Its fallen comrades continue to fight alongside their leader, empowering them with ghostly aura. This power allows it to face even the strongest armies without faltering.
cobblemon.species.falinks-gunslinger.des: The five individuals stack on top of each other, acting as one. Their towering position allows them to more easily aim and fire with the cannons on their heads, with less risk of friendly fire. The brass on the top of the stack commands the bottom-most trooper and directs them in the direction it wants to go.
cobblemon.species.falinks-last-soldier-m: Through the power of Mega Evolution, the Last Soldier becomes one with its fallen troops. Theirs souls link together to form an unstoppable force able to topple a thousand armies.
cobblemon.species.falinks-gunslinger-meg: Through the power of Mega Evolution, all five troops combined together to form a tank. They work in unison to pilot the machine that is their body. The brass that make up the wheels of the treads get dizzy from rotating after long journeys.
cobblemon.species.nosepyre.name: Nosepyre
cobblemon.species.nosepyre.desc: There is a perpetual motion machine within the body of this Pokémon. It is said that as long as the machine keeps moving, the flame on its head will continue to spin. When its flame stops spinning, so does its life.
cobblemon.species.gildenose.name: Gildenose
cobblemon.species.gildenose.desc: The raging fire within this Pokémon has been quenched, granting it an enlightened peace of mind. Gildenose has mastered regeneration, it is said that if you perform an age-old dance of generations, you will be gifted with life-giving flowers.
cobblemon.species.noseferatu.name: Noseferatu
cobblemon.species.noseferatu.desc: After being exposed to the power of amethyst, this Pokémon was imbued with dark energy allowing it to evolve. It uses its crystal pendent to control the floating amethyst around it. These amethyst crystals can fire beams of energy to attack its foes.
cobblemon.species.djinnferno.name: Djinnferno
cobblemon.species.djinnferno.desc: The infinite flames within its stone body have burst out, granting it immense power. Its body is made entirely of spiritual flames, causing its appearance to resemble that of a genie... Some say that its fire can burn away the impurities of the soul, but none who have attempted have survived.
cobblemon.species.regisculk.name: Regisculk
cobblemon.species.regisculk.desc: Its entire body is comprised of Sculk. The Pokémon's origins are a complete mystery, all that is known about it is that it was hidden away in the Ancient Cities long ago. It is unclear if this Pokémon has any connection to Regigigas, or if the resemblence has a more sinister explanation.
cobblemon.species.carbink-amethyst.desc: This form of Carbink is born during the formation of underground geodes. When light refracts through its amethyst crystals, its psychic powers awaken.
cobblemon.species.carbink-emerald.desc: This form of Carbink is born from the high pressure when mountains form. Its emerald-green glow makes it a favorite of the Villagers.
cobblemon.species.carbink-echo.desc: This form of Carbink is only found in the deepest darkest depths of the caves. It is unknown how it came into being... Its body reverberates with sound, said to be echoes of the past.
cobblemon.species.carbink-quartz.desc: This form of Carbink is born from sediment that was compressed and heated from the Nether's volcanic activity. Its crystals have a glass-like structure, making them very sharp.
cobblemon.species.clarissie.name: Clarissie
cobblemon.species.clarissie.desc: By exerting its psychic powers, Clarissie has to power to create amethyst crystals between its hands. It can shoot beams of light through its crystals to amplify their power.
cobblemon.species.beryllius.name: Beryllius
cobblemon.species.beryllius.desc: Beryllius is able to channel the energy of the earth to create emeralds between its hands. Because of this, it sees no value in traditional wealth, rather it gifts its gemstones to young children who better appreciate their splendor.
cobblemon.species.echolyte.name: Echolyte
cobblemon.species.echolyte.desc: This Pokémon is so rarely seen that many scientists debate whether or not its truly alive. The shards that encircle its body protect its soft spirit-like core. Few people have seen it without its outer shell.
cobblemon.species.velvettia.name: Velvettia
cobblemon.species.velvettia.desc: This Pokémon is meticulous in keeping its crystals pristine. If it gets so much as a scratch, it will retaliate by piercing its foe using its own body as a spear. It makes sure to clean and sharpen its crystals after every battle.
cobblemon.species.phantump-pale.name: Phantump
cobblemon.species.phantump-pale.desc: The spirit of a deceased Phantump. Its wooden body has long-since petrified, becoming hard as stone. During the day it remains as still as a statue, but at night it stirs from its slumber to wander the pale forest it calls home.
cobblemon.species.trevenant-pale.name: Trevenant
cobblemon.species.trevenant-pale.desc: In the dark of night, Trevenant lurks through the dead forest it used to live in. Falsely attributing intruders to the decay of its home, it brutally attacks anything it sees in a blind rage. Its body is made of petrified wood.
cobblemon.species.flabebe-allay.name: Flabébé
cobblemon.species.flabebe-allay.desc: Its body is as light as a feather, letting its wings guide it through wind currents to travel the world. As it flies it hums a beautiful tune.
cobblemon.species.alloette.name: Alloette
cobblemon.species.alloette-vex.name: Alloette
cobblemon.species.alloette.desc: It glides through the meadows singing a graceful lullaby. If it hears music, it can't help but be drawn to it and dance around. They say that if you give an Alloette a gift, it will be loyal to you for the rest of its life.
cobblemon.species.alloette-vex.desc: An Alloette corrupted and changed by dark magic. Its once cheerful demeanor has been replaced with that of a malicious prankster. It fights expertly using an iron sword, swinging and slashing its foes to pieces as it giggles with mischievous glee.
cobblemon.species.alloette-mega.desc: Through the power of Mega Evolution, Alloette's soul has split into two. The two halves work together in unison, bound together by the amethyst crystal they carry between them.
cobblemon.species.alloette-vex-mega.desc: The hatred in its heart has grown strong, bursting from its chest and taking complete control over its soul. The bond it has with its trainer is the only thing keeping it alive.
cobblemon.species.tangela-lush.name: Tangela
cobblemon.species.tangela-lush.desc: Thick moss and vines cover its whole body, preventing anyone from seeing its true appearance. It has an intense fear of the dark, but fears showing its face even more. Because of this, it will stubbornly hide in the shadows if anyone approaches, even despite its fear.
cobblemon.species.tanglare.name: Tanglare
cobblemon.species.tanglare.desc: Because its entire body is obscured by moss and vines, scientists are unsure how it propels itself through the air. When threatened, it will shake its body to create a cloud of spores before disapearing into the shadows.
cobblemon.species.tanglare-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has caused its flowers to bloom much larger and brighter than before. Using the vine on its head its able to hang down from cave ceilings, letting its spores drift down below.
cobblemon.species.golett-copper.name: Golett
cobblemon.species.golett-copper.desc: After the Resealing War thousands of years ago, Copper Goletts were left without purpose. Many were weathered down in the years following, but the remainder have learned to live on.
cobblemon.species.golurk-copper.name: Golurk
cobblemon.species.golurk-copper.desc: The mechanism within its body is said to produce never-ending lightning storms. It patrols the ancient chambers from which it was created. The only thing that stops it from its mission is its copper body aging with time. Once its oxidization reaches critical levels, it stops moving.
cobblemon.species.golurk-copper-mega.des: The massive copper chest it carries is filled with pure Infinity Energy. If opened even a crack, the energy that spills out is enough to power an entire city.
cobblemon.species.clawviathan.name: Clawviathan
cobblemon.species.clawviathan.desc: Clawviathan lives in the deepest trenches of the ocean, propelling itself through the depths by shooting water through its claws. When threatened it blasts its opponent to shreds with draconic energy. Though rare, it has been recorded to sometimes blast holes in the bottom of ships crossing over its territory.
cobblemon.species.spiritube.name: Spiritube
cobblemon.species.spiritube.desc: This Pokémon was born when 108 spirits became trapped within a television broadcast. It remains dormant within its CRT Television, waiting for an unsespecting person to turn on the TV.
cobblemon.species.dhelmise-sculk.name: Dhelmise
cobblemon.species.dhelmise-sculk.desc: When Sculk found its way into the remains of the Giants, this Pokémon was born. The Sculk covering the pickaxe is actually its body, and it uses the tool to dig through the caves looking for uncorrupted spaces. When it finds something, it scatters spores and moves on.
cobblemon.species.meloetta-soprano.name: Meloetta
cobblemon.species.meloetta-acoustic.name: Meloetta
cobblemon.species.meloetta-soprano.desc: Because it is blind, this Pokémon is not afraid of the dark. It lives deep below in the Ancient Cities that remind it of its home. Its soft soprano voice echoes through the caves as it sings and plays its violin, filling the silence with an eerie yet beautiful song. Legends say its music can calm restless spirits.
cobblemon.species.meloetta-acoustic.desc: Meloetta has been empowered by lively spirits roused by its song, blessing it with electric energy. Its mood has brightened, filling it with furvor. Though its still blind, the power of its ancestors has heightened its senses. Because of this, it has removed the bandages covering its eyes, using it to tie its hair in a ponytail.
cobblemon.species.melofly.name: Melofly
cobblemon.species.melofly.desc: Its florescent glow makes a buzzing noise that sounds like a melody, which is where it gets its name from... Be warned, however, because the Melofly emits poisonous dust that can be fatal within seconds of touching your skin. If you come into contact with it, its melodic buzzing may be the last thing you hear.
cobblemon.species.frillish-ghast.name: Frillish
cobblemon.species.frillish-ghast.desc: This Pokémon propels itself through the air by filling its balloon-like body with gas. Though it lives in the Nether, its body can adapt to the amount of moisture in its environment. The more moisture it has, the happier and healthier it is.
cobblemon.species.jellicent-grumpy-ghast: Although normally suited for a more humid environment, this Pokémon has evolved and adapted to survive in the burning hot temperatures of the Nether. Its body is full of super-heated gas, which it uses to shoot flaming rocks down at its opponents.
A fully hydrated Jellicent is a happy Jellicent. After being rescued from the Nether, this Pokémon has evolved and adapted for a more humid environment. Its body is filled with heated gas that it uses to fly. It eats snowballs to keep its body from overheating, and loves to give children rides atop its head.
cobblemon.species.jellicent-apathy-ghast: After facing the vast empty expanse of the End, this Pokémon has evolved and adapted to life in the void. It rarely shows emotion, taking on an almost nihilistic personality. It does, however, love the taste of Nomel Berry flavored Poképuffs.
cobblemon.species.galecadet.name: Galecadet
cobblemon.species.galecadet.desc: This Pokémon trains day in and day out within the Trial Chambers, hoping to become strong enough to wield a powerful weapon and finally evolve. Its body contains a never-ending whirlwind.
cobblemon.species.zephyrouge.name: Zephyrouge
cobblemon.species.zephyrouge.desc: The armor worn upon Zephyrouge's shoulders is made of the heaviest material in the world, yet despite this it lifts it with ease. In battle, its shoulder pads connect together to form a large mace. By jumping high into the sky and slamming down, it lets out a burst of wind strong enough to topple an entire forest.
cobblemon.species.ceruclone.name: Ceruclone
cobblemon.species.ceruclone.desc: Ceruclone's trident crackles with the power of a thousand tempests. It channels electrical energy through the trident to shoot beams of lightning at its foe. By twirling it above its head, it is said to be able to call down thunderstorms.
This Pokémon's body is made of thick slabs of sandstone. Once every full moon, they gather around the ancient desert pyramids in a circle to summon forth a sandstorm.
cobblemon.species.stonjourner-mega-sands: It stands in the middle of the desert as a monument of safety. Its body acts as shelter for wild Pokémon caught amidst raging sandstorms.
cobblemon.species.snowygast.name: Snowygast
cobblemon.species.snowygast.desc: The remains of a melted snowman possessed by the grudges of the dead. Anyone who puts on its hat will be forced to do its bidding, piling up snow to make its body bigger.
cobblemon.species.palossnow.name: Palossnow
cobblemon.species.palossnow.desc: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its snow mound into a fortress. It fires barrages of snowballs from the hollows in its arms, attempting to bury its prey in snow so it can trap them and drain their vitality.
cobblemon.species.wimpod-silverfish.name: Wimpod
cobblemon.species.wimpod-silverfish.desc: Swarms of this Pokémon patrol the underground Strongholds. They inhabit the bricks and stone around the structure, lying in wait and multiplying their numbers. When threatened, they will all attack at once, calling upon their allies for help... But alone, they are defenseless and weak.
cobblemon.species.wimpod-silverfish-swar: When threatened, this Pokémon will call upon its allies for help. Alone they are defenseless and weak, but together they become a formidable force to be reckoned with.
cobblemon.species.golisopede.name: Golisopede
cobblemon.species.golisopede.desc: When the Wimpod swarm is threatened, they call upon the largest Golisopede for help. It burrows through the ground at high speeds, using vibrations to sense its prey. When it locates its foe, it bursts from the floor to strike them with deadly efficiency. Its armor is powerful enough to burrow through solid stone bricks.
cobblemon.species.golisopede-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has heightened its burrowing tendencies, causing it to cover its body in stone bricks to recreate the feeling of being underground. This doubles as armor, which it uses to bash any foe who challenges the swarm.
cobblemon.species.seedlin.name: Seedlin
cobblemon.species.seedlin.desc: An ancient ancestor of Applin. It spends its entire life inside of a hard protective seed. The type of seed it inhabits determines its evolution, but its impossible to tell at this stage of developement.
cobblemon.species.torchlin.name: Torchlin
cobblemon.species.torchlin.desc: The seed has finally sprouted, revealing a bright Torchflower. Torchlin's latent fire has awakened, allowing it to shoot bursts of flames from its petals.
cobblemon.species.podlin.name: Podlin
cobblemon.species.podlin.desc: The pod has finally sprouted, revealing a bulbous Pitcher Plant. Podlin's ability to grow has strengthened, allowing it to nurse any plant back to life no matter how wilted.
cobblemon.species.torchflyer.name: Torchflyer
cobblemon.species.torchflyer.desc: The seed that it lived in has fully grown, becoming part of its body. Its sprouted vine-like wings that it uses to soar through the sky, spewing flames to burn down shrubbery to make the soil more suitable for planting.
cobblemon.species.pitchertun.name: Pitchertun
cobblemon.species.pitchertun.desc: The seed that it lived in has fully grown, becoming part of its body. Its back is covered in lush moss and blooming pitcher plants. The sweet scent of its flowers attracts bugs, causing them to get trapped in the liquid within the pods. Once this liquid dissolves its catch, Pitchertun pours it onto plants to help them grow.
cobblemon.species.sephiredge.name: Sephiredge
cobblemon.species.sephiredge.desc: This powerful Pokémon is rumored to be an evolution of Honedge from an alternate timeline. Its true origins are unknown, many debate whether it is a Paradox Pokémon, a Mythical Pokémon, or something else entirely... What is known is that it emanates a malicious aura and can cut through solid steel with ease.
cobblemon.species.roselia-wither-rose.de: This Pokémon's roses have withered and turned black. Its pollen is highly poisonous, causing severe pain and anguish for anyone who inhales it... Prolonged exposure to this pollen will lead to a slow and painful death.
cobblemon.species.roserade-wither-rose.d: Its petals emit a toxin so powerful it can stop a man's heart with a single touch. When it encounters another living being, it mindlessly attacks them with sharp thorns coated in these same toxins.
cobblemon.species.stygipede.name: Stygipede
cobblemon.species.stygipede.desc: This Pokémon is a close relative of Sizzlipede that evolved and adapted to living in the Deep Dark. It burrows through Sculk to eat up impurities, forming a symbiotic relationship with the Sculk. Due to the darkness of the caves, it has lost its eyes and become blind. Instead it uses vibrations in the ground to sense its surroundings.
cobblemon.species.centisculk.name: Centisculk
cobblemon.species.centisculk.desc: Centisculk lives within patches of Sculk, burrowing through it to eat up decaying matter. When it sense vibrations, it bursts from the ground to viciously attack its prey. This prey then gets absorbed into the Sculk, from which Centisculk gets its nutrients.
cobblemon.species.morelull-crimson.name: Morelull
cobblemon.species.morelull-warped.name: Morelull
cobblemon.species.morelull-crimson.desc: This form of Morelull is adapted to live in the Crimson Forest biome. It absorbs heat from the ground using its mycelium, and uses that energy to light its mushroom cap. When eaten, its cap is said to have an extremely spicy flavor.
cobblemon.species.morelull-warped.desc: This form of Morelull is adapted to live in the Warped Forest biome. It flashes its lights in a rythmic pulse to hypnotize its prey, then latches onto them to drain their vitality. When eaten, its cap is said to have an extremely sour flavor.
cobblemon.species.shiinotic-crimson.name: Shiinotic
cobblemon.species.shiinotic-warped.name: Shiinotic
cobblemon.species.shiinotic-crimson.desc: This Shiinotic has evolved to match the Crimson Forest it lives in. The vines hanging from its mushroom cap are specialized to absorb heat from the Nether air, powering the Pokémon's inner light. It fires beams of light from its mushroom cap to burn its foes.
cobblemon.species.shiinotic-warped.desc: This Shiinotic has evolved to match the Warped Forest it lives in. It lures in prey with its hypnotic lights, before coating them in mind-controlling spores.
cobblemon.species.breezior.name: Breezior
cobblemon.species.breezior.desc: A distant relative of Minior. Although most of Breezior's body is made of wind, at the very center of its core is a small meteorite. It lives in Trial Chambers, and its origins are theorized to be directly linked to the Breeze.
cobblemon.species.porytron.name: Porytron
cobblemon.species.porytron.desc: A powerful magical construct of unknown origin. Some wizards have spent a lifetime trying to understand how such a creature exists, none have succeeded.
cobblemon.species.porytron2.name: Porytron2
cobblemon.species.porytron2.desc: Through melding with an artifact, a Porytron may reconfigure itself into a Porytron2. This form has greater power, but its purpose is still unknown.
cobblemon.species.porytronz.name: Porytron-Z
cobblemon.species.porytronz.desc: A strange disc has upgraded this Pokémon, transforming it into a high-speed magical transportation device. Some wizards believe this form to be evidence of the Humanoid Construct Theory.
cobblemon.species.shade.name: Shade
cobblemon.species.tomledger.name: Tomledger
cobblemon.species.tomledger.desc: This Pokémon is said to be born from the spirit of a sorcerer who sealed away their power inside of a book. The words on its pages are seemingly indecipherable, but allow it to cast numerous spells.
cobblemon.species.twinledger.name: Twinledger
cobblemon.species.twinledger.desc: The two sheathes act together in unison, combining their minds together to cast spells. If one gets distracted and the two aren't in sync, their spells will missfire.
cobblemon.species.wizledger.name: Wizledger
cobblemon.species.wizledger-fire-spell.d: The seal containing it has split open, releasing the spirit that resides within. The flame of its magic burns bright, returning the magic it once had in life.
cobblemon.species.wizledger-ice-spell.de: The seal containing it has split open, releasing the spirit that resides within. Its ice magic radiates from it, allowing it to freeze opponents with its spells.
cobblemon.species.wizledger-lightning-sp: The seal containing it has split open, releasing the spirit that resides within. Its body cracks with magical electricity, calling down lightning strikes by speaking incantations.
cobblemon.species.petilil-winter.name: Petilil
cobblemon.species.petilil-winter.desc: This form of Petilil is adapted to thrive in frigid cold climates.
cobblemon.species.lilligant-winter.name: Lilligant
cobblemon.species.lilligant-winter.desc: The garland on its head is often mistaken for a flower. In reality its red petals are actually leaves. They turn a bright shade of red during winter, making it very popular during the holidays.
cobblemon.species.klinklang-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has converted its body into a living engine. The gears that make up its body act in unison to propel it across the ground at high speeds. It can reach speeds of over 230 mph.
cobblemon.species.darmanitan-mega-z.desc: Although it appears to be asleep, its mind is awake. Mega Evolution has allowed this Pokémon to open its third eye, granting it a deep sense of understanding. It uses its control over its own mind to unleash its latent psychic power.
cobblemon.species.gimmibread.name: Gimmibread
cobblemon.species.gimmibread.desc: This Pokémon was baked in an ancient oven about 1,500 years ago. In some regions there is a tradition of giving Gimmibread to loved ones during the holidays, which is said to bring good luck.
cobblemon.species.gimmibread-roaming.des: This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped into a cookie. It runs runs runs as fast as it can to escape from wild Pokémon who might try to eat it.
cobblemon.species.gholdendough.name: Gholdendough
cobblemon.species.gholdendough.desc: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 cookies. This Pokémon is a favorite during the holidays, and is always eager to help bake gingerbread cookies.
cobblemon.species.electrode-mega.desc: Through Mega Evolution its appearance has changed to resemble a Master Ball. Contained within its body is a large quantity of Infinity Energy, which it releases to cause cataclysmic explosions.
cobblemon.species.dudunsparce-mega-x.des: Mega Evolution has awakened its dormant genes, elongating its body into a serpent-like form. Using its tiny wings, it flies through the air as if pretending to be a majestic dragon.
cobblemon.species.dudunsparce-mega-y.des: Mega Evolution has awakened its dormant genes, causing its wings to grow large allowing it to take flight. By flapping its wings it can stir up hurricanes to attack its foes.
cobblemon.species.sewaddle-clockwork.des: A robotic recreation that resembles the Pokémon Sewaddle. This robotic Pokémon flutters around, using its little claws to scratch off dust and decay. It continues this task even centuries after it was created.
cobblemon.species.swadloon-clockwork.des: A robotic recreation that resembles the Pokémon Swadloon. It was built to withstand intense heat, carrying out its task in spite of harsh conditions. Over time, however, its heatproofing has become less reliable than it once was.
cobblemon.species.leavanny-clockwork.des: A robotic recreation that resembles the Pokémon Leavanny. Though its exact origin is unknown, it appears to have been built long ago. It dances a perpetual dance, a novelty considering how archaic the technology is.
cobblemon.species.leavanny-mega-clockwor: The spool of silk that powers the machine has split open, causing the silk to pour out uncontrollably. Its unclear how it still functions, some believe its only able to sustain itself in this form by using Mega Energy as its power source.

cobblemon.ability.normalmastery.desc: The Pokémon can hit Normal-immune Pokémon with Normal-type moves. It also takes no damage when hit by Normal-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted. This Pokémon's attacks ignore the target's ability.

cobblemon.ability.sweetdreams.desc: Heals ally Pokémon that are asleep.
cobblemon.battle.heal.sweetdreams: %1$s restored a little HP from Sweet Dreams!
cobblemon.ability.bombard.desc: Powers up ball and bomb moves.
cobblemon.ability.hotsand.desc: The Pokémon body is made of hot sand that prevents it from being burned. Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
cobblemon.ability.forestspirit.desc: Powers up the Grass-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
cobblemon.ability.shrieker.desc: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon is also immune to these kinds of moves.
cobblemon.ability.windcharge.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
cobblemon.ability.intellectual.desc: Powers up Psychic-type moves. Also halves damage taken from Psychic-type moves.
cobblemon.ability.paperthin.desc: The Pokémon is made of paper, increasing damage recieved from Fire- and Water-type moves. When hit by a Fire- or Water-type move, its Speed stat is sharply boosted. Reduces HP in rain, takes increased damage from Burn, but has an increased critical-hit ratio.
cobblemon.ability.misdirection.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
cobblemon.ability.snowguard.desc: The Pokémon shields itself in a coating of frost. Halves damage taken from moves that are super effective against Ice-type when in snow or hail.
cobblemon.ability.turbocharge.desc: The Pokémon is turbocharged with electricity, which powers up Electric-type moves and halves the damage taken from Electric-type moves. When hit by an electric type move, its speed stat is boosted.
cobblemon.ability.recluse.desc: The Pokémon is reclusive, keeping it from or falling for taunt, torment, or encore. This also lowers the Pokémon's Speed stat if intimidated.
cobblemon.ability.zendomain.desc: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The Pokémon also gradually regains HP in Psychic Terrain.
cobblemon.ability.mastermind.desc: Normal-type moves become Psychic-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
cobblemon.ability.swarming.desc: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful swarm. It stops swarming when its HP is low.
cobblemon.ability.hivemind.desc: Powers up the Bug-type and Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
cobblemon.move.combattorque.desc: The user attacks the target with a twisting drift. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
cobblemon.move.blazingtorque.desc: The user attacks the target with a burning drift. This may also leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.wickedtorque.desc: The user attacks the target with a wicked drift. This may also incude sleep.
cobblemon.move.noxioustorque.desc: The user attacks the target with a noxious drift. This may also poison the target.
cobblemon.move.magicaltorque.desc: The user attacks the target with a magical drift. This may also confuse the target.
cobblemon.move.pumpkinbomb.desc: The user attacks everything around it by igniting an explosive pumpkin. This also damages the user quite a lot and may leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.firebomb.desc: The throws a flaming explosive at the target, leaving them with a burn.
cobblemon.move.bulletbarrage.desc: The user forcefully shoots metal bullets at the target two to five times in a row.
cobblemon.move.digdeep.desc: The user digs into the target using its body as a pickaxe. This move is super effective on Ground-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.move.dragonpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.holdtheline.desc: The user rallies their troops to stand their ground and sharply boosts their Defense and Sp. Def. This prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
cobblemon.move.laststand.desc: The user makes their final stand, boosting their speed and sharply boosting their Attack and Sp. Atk. This prevents the user from switching out for fleeing.
cobblemon.move.magictrick.desc: The user performs a magic trick to switch its Attack with its Sp. Atk stat.
cobblemon.battle.activate.magictrick: %1$s switched its Attack and Sp. Atk!
cobblemon.move.nightterror.desc: The user devours the dreams of a sleeping target, leaving behind nothing but nightmares. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.sleepcharm.desc: The user sprinkles magic sand onto the opponent to put them to sleep. If it succeeds, the user restores 1/4th of their HP.
cobblemon.move.sandshift.desc: The user shoots sand at the target before rushing to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
cobblemon.move.sonicshriek.desc: The user attacks by firing a sonically-charged shriek from its chest.
cobblemon.move.terrainblade.desc: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
cobblemon.move.vitaldrain.desc: The user bites into the target's vitals to drain them of their blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.vitalslash.desc: The user slashes the target's vitals to drain them of their blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
cobblemon.move.spiritsong.desc: The user belts out an ancient song to lift the spirits of the past. This causes sleeping Pokémon to wake up.
cobblemon.move.phantomblade.desc: The user tears at the target with its ghostly blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and never misses.
cobblemon.move.steelcutter.desc: The user slashes the target with steel blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.snowbank.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in snow or hail.
cobblemon.move.pitfall.desc: The user creates a pitfall to trip the target. This move enables the user to attack first, but fails if the target is not readying an attack.
cobblemon.move.breezeball.desc: The user hurls a wind charge at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
cobblemon.move.papercut.desc: The user attacks by slicing the target with a blade as thin as paper. This move always lands a critical hit.
cobblemon.move.bygonebash.desc: The user throws a mighty punch using combined power of the spirits of its ancestors. This also damages the user quite a lot.
cobblemon.move.psychicsnap.desc: The user sends out a shockwave of psychic power capable of shattering glass. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
cobblemon.move.generationdance.desc: The user performs the dance of its ancestors, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP. It regains more HP in harsh sunlight.
cobblemon.move.vengeanceofgenerations.de: The user attacks with the full force of a thousand generations. This move ignores the target's Ability and Immunities.
cobblemon.move.gmaxpresto.desc: A Fairy-type attack that Gigantamax Hattertainer uses. This may also make targets flinch or leave them with a burn.
cobblemon.move.shiverdance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, shivering dance. This boosts the user's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. The user's Attack and Sp. Atk stat are raised sharply when its snowing.
cobblemon.move.pageturn.desc: The user turns a page of its spell book. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats. When used by Twinledger it changes form.
cobblemon.move.magicmissile.desc: The user attacks the target by casting a mighty spell. This move becomes the same type as the user's type.
cobblemon.move.guardpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its stone body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.armorpress.desc: The user attacks by slamming its armored body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.mindbend.desc: The user attacks the target with mental fortitude. The higher the user's Sp. Def stat, the greater the damage this move deals. This may also confuse the target.
cobblemon.move.letitcook.desc: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of cookies. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. May leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.glacialcrash.desc: The user attacks by slamming its icy body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
cobblemon.move.psydrive.desc: The user delivers an powerful psychic kick to attack the target. This move deals special damage.
cobblemon.move.eeriedance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, unsettling dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
cobblemon.move.crystalspear.desc: The user pierces the target with a crystalline spear. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and never misses.
cobblemon.move.fleurdance.desc: The user performs an elegant flowery dance to strike the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
